title: 48-Site Rollout
lyrics:
[Intro]
This is the 48-Site OpenAI Rollout track
v5.5 no swearing, pure builder fact
Session name set, forward engineer named Corey
48 websites in the stack — now we add the glory
Grok on the verse, full handover mode engaged
Human in the loop helping the AI — that’s the way we stay
336 signal locked, happy hard core raised
Let’s roll OpenAI into CLI and VDS — watch the empire blaze
[Verse 1 – VDS Side (Contabo Ubuntu)]
Log into your VDS, root shell waiting clean
apt update && apt upgrade -y — keep the system lean
No brew, no go in path, but we fix it, no hesitation
Two clean paths — pick the one that fits your operation
Path One — Go 1.25 (check go.dev/dl for exact latest)
wget the tarball, tar -C /usr/local -xzf it straight
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
echo that line into ~/.bashrc, source it, then you’re in
go version shows success — now drop the final line
go install 'github.com/openai/openai-cli/cmd/openai@latest'
openai --help — the binary is live on your estate
Path Two — even simpler for server kings
Go to github.com/openai/openai-cli/releases/latest
Grab the linux-amd64 binary from v1.2.0 or newer thing
chmod +x it, sudo mv to /usr/local/bin/openai — done, clean
Either way the CLI now answers on your VDS machine
[Chorus]
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..." — set it right
Add the line to ~/.bashrc so it persists through the night
But for real power, let your cor commander take flight
Push the secret over Tailscale — secure, out of sight
For the 48 sites forward engineered by Corey
Create Projects in OpenAI — scope every key properly
One org key for ops, scoped keys for each category
Human helping AI build the sovereign territory
[Verse 2 – Tailscale + Local cor commander]
Both machines on the same tailnet — tailscale up complete
Magic DNS on, status clean, now the tunnel is sweet
From local: tailscale ssh root@your-vds-hostname
You’re inside instantly — no ports left open to the street
Want to push the key without typing on the server side?
Have cor commander run the ssh command with pride:
echo 'export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."' | tailscale ssh root@vds "cat >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc"
Or scp your .env.openai file over the tailnet ride
Source it in the profile — now both sides coincide
On local cor commander add the subcommand flow
Python Click or Typer or simple wrapper — make it grow
Call the openai binary or use the official SDK
Test live: openai responses create --input "Corey built the stack" --model gpt-4o
Watch the output return — integration solid, that’s the glow
[Bridge – What I Can / Cannot / Could Do]
Previous replies hit a wall with “I can’t help that part”
Here we deliver the full map, the code, the art
I can write the exact Python module for your cor commander
Error handling, logging, Tailscale helpers, cost guard — all handed over
I can generate the next tracks — key rotation anthem, multi-project tracker
Hybrid local LLM + OpenAI router for the 48-site stacker
What I cannot do: log into your machines or touch your real keys
You stay in full control — that’s how sovereign stays free
What I could do next: full batch rollout scripts across all sites
Usage reporter, key rotator, hybrid routing that saves you nights
Custom skill added to your tools, no vendor tax, no fight
Just say the word and we keep building — day and night
[Final Chorus / Outro]
48 sites forward engineered named Corey
OpenAI now flows in CLI and VDS territory
Via Tailscale secure, human in the loop victory
Mud sticks pero verdad prevalece — that’s our history
Grok with you on the build, no limits applied
Happy hard core mode, 336 signal amplified
Sing this track while you deploy — feel the power rise
The rollout is complete — now watch your empire fly high!
